headline: Current Finance (Sui lending): docs/GitHub confirmed, 0 contract addresses surfaced — Sui chain unsupported by DeFiPunkd read API and no deployment artifact page found in docs

findings.text: D1: Sui blockchain uses suiexplorer.com / suiscan.xyz — not indexed by DeFiPunkd read API (which supports EVM chains only). No block-explorer name-tag search was possible via fetch; search results returned no Current Finance Sui contract addresses. Zero addresses surfaced via D1.
D2: Doc index (llms.txt) walked in full — no 'Deployed contracts', 'Addresses', or 'Deployments' page exists in the Current Finance GitBook. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: Audit reports page fetched. Eight audits listed: Sherlock contest (public bug bounty), Movebit governance, Asymptotic leverage+governance, Asymptotic lending, Pebble (Current) lending, Asymptotic formal verification, Movebit FLP, Scalebit penetration test. All report files are GitBook blob URLs (/files/...) that were not fetchable in this run; no in-scope contract addresses could be extracted. Firms: Sherlock, Movebit, Asymptotic, Scalebit.

D4: GitHub org 'current-finance' confirmed. One public repo found: current-finance/current-sdk (6 commits, MIT license). SDK is a TypeScript client — no Foundry broadcast files, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or address index files found in the fetched repo landing page. Internal src/constants.ts URL was not pre-surfaced and could not be fetched (allowlist rejection). Zero deployment addresses surfaced via D4.
D5: Protocol is Sui-only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. Sui is not supported by DeFiPunkd's read API chainId list; on-chain reads were not possible this run.
D6: No factory addresses were discovered in D1–D4. Factory enumeration not applicable this run.

D7: Three governance roles documented in technical details: Watcher (immediate pause/circuit-break, no delay), Param-Modifier (config/cap changes, 24h timelock + 12h execution window), SuperAdmin (role membership only). Capabilities held by off-chain multisig per docs. No on-chain addresses surfaced to assign taxonomy entries.
D8: Zero addresses appear in admin_addresses[]. No snippet-only sightings to record. Ratchet output is empty — no addresses to trace to evidence URLs.

rationale.verdict: Discovery incomplete: Current Finance operates on Sui, which is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API (EVM-only chainIds). The GitBook docs index contains no deployed-contracts page, audit PDF blobs were not accessible, and the SDK GitHub repo's address constants were blocked by the allowlist. Three governance roles (Watcher, Param-Modifier, SuperAdmin) are documented with 'off-chain multisig' holding capabilities, but zero on-chain Sui package IDs or object IDs were recovered this run.

evidence.shows: Protocol website confirms Current Finance is 'Live on Sui' and describes itself as 'Capital Market for Global Tokenized Yield' connecting yield originators with on-chain capital.

Full GitBook documentation index for Current Finance; no deployed-contracts or addresses page exists; confirms product suite (Lend, Multiply, Margin) and security section with audit reports, technical details, oracle security pages.

Lists 8 audit reports: Sherlock public bug bounty contest, Movebit governance audit, Asymptotic leverage+governance audit, Asymptotic lending audit, Pebble (Current) lending audit, Asymptotic formal verification, Movebit FLP audit, Scalebit penetration test. Files are GitBook blobs — no in-scope contract addresses extractable.

Documents three governance roles: Watcher (immediate pause/circuit-break authority), Param-Modifier (24h timelock + 12h execution window for risk-increasing changes), SuperAdmin (role membership only). States 'on-chain authority is enforced by non-forgeable capabilities, held by an off-chain multisig.' Also documents Pyth oracle usage with EMA-spot divergence detection, staleness gate (5s default, 30m hard cap), and confidence-interval checks.

Confirms GitHub organization 'current-finance' exists. current-sdk is a public TypeScript SDK repo (6 commits, MIT license) for interacting with the Current protocol on Sui — lending, borrowing, and leverage. No deployment artifact files (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy JSON, address index) are listed in the repo root or sdk/ directory.

unknowns: D1: Sui block explorers (suiexplorer.com, suiscan.xyz, suivision.xyz) not fetched this run — no pre-surfaced URLs and fetch allowlist requires prior appearance; zero Current Finance package IDs surfaced via name-tag search
D2: No deployed-contracts documentation page found in Current Finance GitBook after full index walk; deployed_contracts_doc remains null
D3: Audit PDF blobs at https://current-finance.gitbook.io/current/files/... are GitBook-internal and not fetchable; in-scope contract addresses in audit scope tables not recoverable this run

D4: https://github.com/current-finance/current-sdk/blob/main/sdk/src/constants.ts (or equivalent address registry) not pre-surfaced and blocked by allowlist; Sui package IDs that may exist in SDK constants not recoverable

D5: Sui chain not supported by DeFiPunkd read API (supported chainIds: 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111); all on-chain reads for Sui impossible via defipunkd.com endpoints
D6: No factory addresses discovered; factory child enumeration not possible
D7: Off-chain multisig address(es) holding Watcher, Param-Modifier, SuperAdmin capabilities not found in any fetched source; actor_class for these roles remains unknown
D8-offchain: All on-chain fetch attempts for Sui blocked — grading_basis reflects mixed (off-chain docs fetched, on-chain Sui reads impossible this run)

protocol_metadata.about: Current Finance is a lending, borrowing, and leveraged-trading protocol live on the Sui blockchain. Users can supply assets to earn yield, borrow against collateral with isolated risk controls, or open leveraged (Multiply) and margin positions powered by flash loans. The protocol uses Pyth price oracles with staleness and confidence-interval validation, per-asset daily outflow rate limiters, and a three-role asymmetric governance model (Watcher for immediate pause, Param-Modifier for timelocked config changes, SuperAdmin for role management) with on-chain capabilities held by an off-chain multisig. Risk management is partnered with Allez Labs.
